string.name: mail_name
string.description: Spoken and shown name of the tool

string.name: mail_launcher_label
string.description: Launcher name, so the user can say Open Mail Reader

string.name: mail_button
string.description: Button on the camera screen that opens the tool

string.name: mail_button_description
string.description: Accessibility description of that button

resources.string: Open mail reader. Says who a letter is from and what it\'s about, then reads it.

string.name: mail_help
string.description: Spoken list of what can be said in this tool

resources.string: Hold up a letter or envelope about a foot from your face. You can say: what is this letter, read it all, who\'s it from, who\'s it for, how much, when is it due, is it junk, what\'s the reference number, read the envelope, next page, new letter, stop, carry on, back, skip, start again, or close.

string.name: mail_welcome
string.description: Spoken when the tool opens

resources.string: Hold up a letter or envelope and say: what is this letter.

string.name: mail_looking
string.description: Spoken when a photo of the letter is being taken

string.name: mail_looking_page
string.description: Spoken when photographing another page

string.name: mail_still_looking
string.description: Spoken if the user asks again while still reading the photo

string.name: mail_still_working
string.description: Spoken if reading the letter takes a while

string.name: mail_capture_failed
string.description: Photo from the glasses failed

resources.string: I couldn\'t get a photo from your glasses. Say read to try again.

string.name: mail_ocr_failed
string.description: Text recognition failed

resources.string: Sorry, I couldn\'t read that. Say read to try again.

string.name: mail_no_text
string.description: Nothing readable in the photo

resources.string: I can\'t see any writing. Hold the letter about a foot from your face, flat and facing you, then say read.

string.name: mail_low_confidence
string.description: Text too blurred

resources.string: I can\'t read this clearly. Hold the letter still, in good light, then say read.

string.name: mail_too_small
string.description: Text too small

resources.string: The writing is too small. Bring the letter a little closer, then say read.

string.name: mail_hint_covered
string.description: Lens covered

resources.string: Something is covering the camera. Check nothing is over the left side of your glasses, then say read.

string.name: mail_hint_dark
string.description: Too dark

resources.string: It\'s too dark to read. Turn on a light, then say read.

string.name: mail_hint_nothing
string.description: No letter in view

resources.string: I can\'t see a letter. Hold it up about a foot in front of your face, then say read.

string.name: mail_cut_right
string.description: Letter cut off at the right

resources.string: The letter looks cut off on the right. Turn your head a little right, or move the letter left, and say read again.

string.name: mail_cut_left
string.description: Letter cut off at the left

resources.string: The letter looks cut off on the left. Turn your head a little left, and say read again.

string.name: mail_cut_top
string.description: Letter cut off at the top

resources.string: The top of the letter looks cut off. Tilt your head up a little, and say read again.

string.name: mail_cut_bottom
string.description: Letter cut off at the bottom

resources.string: The bottom of the letter looks cut off. Tilt your head down a little, and say next page or read again.

string.name: mail_too_close
string.description: Letter too close

resources.string: The letter doesn\'t fit. Hold it a little further away, and say read again.

string.name: mail_same_page
string.description: Next page photo shows the same page

resources.string: That looks like the same page. Turn it over, then say next page.

string.name: mail_page_added
string.description: Another page was added; %1$d is the number of pages

string.name: mail_no_letter
string.description: Asked something before any letter was read

resources.string: I haven\'t read a letter yet. Hold one up and say: what is this letter.

string.name: mail_end
string.description: Read it all reached the end

resources.string: That\'s the end of the letter. Say start again, next page, or hold up another letter and say read.

string.name: mail_paused
string.description: Reading paused by voice

resources.string: Paused. Say carry on to continue.

string.name: mail_nothing_to_resume
string.description: Carry on with nothing being read

resources.string: Say read it all to hear the letter, or hold up a letter and say read.

string.name: mail_at_start
string.description: Back at the first sentence

resources.string: That\'s the start of the letter.

string.name: mail_nudge_idle
string.description: Reminder when nothing has happened

resources.string: Hold up a letter and say: what is this letter. Or say help.

string.name: mail_nudge_ready
string.description: Reminder after a summary

resources.string: Say read it all, how much, or who\'s it from. Or hold up another letter and say new letter.

string.name: mail_nudge_paused
string.description: Reminder while paused

resources.string: Reading is paused. Say carry on to continue.

string.name: mail_nudge_last
string.description: Last reminder

resources.string: I\'ll stay quiet now. Say help any time.

string.name: mail_title
string.description: Title for the ask-about-the-text seam; %1$s is the sender

string.name: mail_status_looking
string.description: Status while photographing and reading

string.name: mail_status_ready
string.description: Status after a summary

resources.string: Letter read. Say read it all to hear every word.

string.name: mail_status_reading
string.description: Status while reading every word

string.name: mail_status_paused
string.description: Status while paused

string.name: mail_action_summarise
string.description: Button: photograph and summarise

string.name: mail_action_read_all
string.description: Button: read every word

string.name: mail_action_pause
string.description: Button: pause reading

string.name: mail_action_resume
string.description: Button: carry on reading

string.name: mail_action_back
string.description: Button: back a sentence

string.name: mail_action_next_page
string.description: Button: add another page

string.name: mail_action_how_much
string.description: Button: how much is due

string.name: mail_label_kind
string.description: Label on screen; %1$s is the kind of letter

string.name: mail_label_from
string.description: Label on screen; %1$s is the sender

string.name: mail_label_for
string.description: Label on screen; %1$s is the recipient

string.name: mail_label_date
string.description: Label on screen; %1$s is the date

string.name: mail_label_about
string.description: Label on screen; %1$s is the subject

string.name: mail_label_amount
string.description: Label on screen; %1$s is the amount line

string.name: mail_label_due
string.description: Label on screen; %1$s is the deadline line

string.name: mail_label_pages
string.description: Label on screen; %1$d is the number of pages

string.name: mail_unknown
string.description: A field that couldn't be read

string.name: mail_amount_unsure
string.description: Screen text for an amount that can't be read for sure

string.name: mail_amount_conflict
string.description: Screen text when two amounts disagree

string.name: mail_sentence_heading
string.description: Heading above the sentence being read

string.name: mail_text_heading
string.description: Heading above the full letter text
